episodes.title: The Magic That Started Everything
episodes.synopsis: Coco, a girl fascinated by magic, meets Qifrey and discovers the secrets of witches.

episodes.title: The School of the Grassland
episodes.synopsis: Coco meets her fellow students and starts to learn the fundamentals of magic.

episodes.title: The Dadah Range Test
episodes.synopsis: While Qifrey is away, Agott pushes Coco into taking a dangerous test.

episodes.title: Meeting In Kalhn
episodes.synopsis: Qifrey takes Coco to the witches' town of Kalhn, where she has an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: The Dragon's Labyrinth
episodes.synopsis: The four apprentice witches strive to find a solution to their calamitous situation.

episodes.title: A Light on a Rainy Day
episodes.synopsis: On a rainy day, the apprentices enjoy a picnic outside and meet their Watchful Eye.

episodes.title: Who Is Magic For?
episodes.synopsis: The apprentices are allowed to come along on a dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.title: The Misgivings of the Knights Moralis
episodes.synopsis: When the Knights Moralis arrive, Coco and Agott must deal with the aftermath of their actions.

episodes.title: A Nightmare Stained In Black
episodes.synopsis: Qifrey investigates a new clue to the Brimmed Caps while Coco continues to struggle with guilt.

episodes.title: A Promise in Silver
episodes.synopsis: Coco lies ill in the hospital, while Tartah gains new self-confidence through magic.

episodes.title: The Test in Serpentback Cave
episodes.synopsis: Richeh reveals her distaste for spells that are not her own, while Agott gets the date for her second test.

episodes.title: The Shadow of Romonon
episodes.synopsis: Qifrey tells Coco the history of the Romonon cave, while Agott and the examinees face its topsy-turvy magic.

episodes.title: Forbidden Magic
episodes.synopsis: Trapped in the Serpentback Cave, Agott, Richeh, and Euini face a terrifying threat from a Brimmed Cap witch.

episodes.title: Her "Xs"
episodes.synopsis: When Sung-hee attempts to expose Ah-jin's secrets, she strikes back with the help of fellow classmates.

episodes.title: The Moment a Human Becomes a Devil
episodes.synopsis: Ah-jin is accepted into her dream law school, but her dreams are crushed when her father returns.

episodes.title: Breaking the Shackles
episodes.synopsis: With her dream shattered, Ah-jin begins to work at a cafe and secretly schemes to manipulate Jung-ho.

episodes.title: No Turning Back
episodes.synopsis: As suspicions fall on Ah-jin with nowhere to turn, she is approached by Mi-ri, who steps in to save her.

episodes.title: Grant Me the Power to Rise to the Top
episodes.synopsis: Ah-jin makes her debut as an actress and grows increasingly wary of Lena.

episodes.title: Setting the Trap
episodes.synopsis: Determined to advance her career, Ah-jin sets her sights on top star, Heo In-gang.

episodes.title: The Wheel of Fate
episodes.synopsis: Ah-jin's year-long romance with In-gang deepens, but her past is at risk of being exposed.

episodes.title: Before Judgment
episodes.synopsis: After his grandmother's passing, In-gang proposes, but Ah-jin ends their relationship instead.

episodes.title: New Heights
episodes.synopsis: As Ah-jin faces public backlash for her break up with In-gang, a wealthy savior comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: The Monster in the Mirror
episodes.synopsis: Jun-seo learns the secret of his birth and leaves Ah-jin’s side while she marries Do-hyuk.

episodes.title: Save Me, My God
episodes.synopsis: Ah-jin discovers the unnerving truth about her husband. Desperate to break free, she turns to Jae-oh.

episodes.title: The Final X
episodes.synopsis: Ah-jin’s deepest darkest secrets are revealed just as she rises to the very top.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: After Girigo grants Choi Hyeong-wook a wish, he introduces the app to his friends, who brush him off. But soon, his behavior grows concerning.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: After a sudden tragedy, Yoo Se-ah realizes Kim Geon-woo may be next and rallies her friends to find a solution. But Girigo proves too sinister to stop.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Seeking to cast out evil, Kang Ha-joon takes Se-ah to his shaman sister — sending her to a cursed space filled with fear, trauma and abandonment.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Ha-joon, Se-ah and Bangwool investigate Girigo's origins, chasing an online friend of Hyeong-wook's. They soon discover a house that may hold clues.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: After a wild night out, Lim Na-ri discovers a terrifying truth. Soon, her jealousy takes hold of her as she navigates her feelings for Geon-woo.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Born from innocence, Kwon Si-won's friendship with Do Hye-ryung — steeped in jealousy, resentment and revenge — gives rise to Girigo and the curse.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Facing sabotage from spirits, the group hunts for the original phone. But as they close in on their goal, danger and darkness lurk at every turn.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: On the brink of defeat, Se-ah confronts the evil behind the curse. Can she stop the unending deaths once and for all?

episodes.title: A Voice in the Dark
episodes.synopsis: When Detective Moo Jin Hyuk's wife is brutally murdered, Kang Kwon Joo, an officer with superior auditory abilities, listens on the other end of the 911 call. Three years later, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo find themselves working together.

episodes.title: Healing Mother's Two Faces (1)
episodes.synopsis: Jin Hyuk rushes to get to Bok Rim before it's too late. Kwon Joo compiles officers with varying expertise for her Golden Time Team.

episodes.title: Healing Mother's Two Faces (2)
episodes.synopsis: Time is running out for Ah Ram as Kwon Joo tries to decipher the xylophone sound. Kwon Joo tells Jin Hyuk her side of what happened three years ago.

episodes.title: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (1)
episodes.synopsis: When Go Dong Chul's death is ruled a suicide, Kwon Joo realizes she must take things into her own hands. Jin Hyuk hurries to find the victim, whom he knows personally, of a kidnapping case.

episodes.title: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (2)
episodes.synopsis: The clock is rapidly ticking for Kwon Joo as her captors prepare to bury her alive. Meanwhile, Eun Byul's own life is in danger as she's hidden in a location unknown to the police.

episodes.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (1)
episodes.synopsis: Kyung Il reveals to Kwon Joo that he witnessed her father's murder. Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo go off on their own, feeling closer than ever to finding the perpetrator.

episodes.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (2)
episodes.synopsis: When a dead body falls out of a supposed victim's closet, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo realize the case goes much deeper than they had initially expected.

episodes.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (3)
episodes.synopsis: Jin Hyuk tries to escape the clutches of Good Friend, who don't quite live up to their name. The hunt for the perpetrator continues, but he is not an easy target.

episodes.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (4)
episodes.synopsis: An accusatory post about Hyun Ho appears online. The Center receives multiple calls when a night club suddenly turns into a nightmare.

episodes.title: Devil's Whisperer (1)
episodes.synopsis: Yang Ho Shik ambushes Eun Soo while Jin Hyuk and Dae Shik are led astray. Things become even more personal when Dong Woo is put in danger.

episodes.title: Devil's Whisperer (2)
episodes.synopsis: The elusive Nam Sang Tae prepares to flee the country, but the police are determined not to let him get away this time. A 911 call brings the Golden Time Team to a hostage situation on a rooftop.

episodes.title: A Call From the Fiery Pit
episodes.synopsis: Kwon Joo realizes they may have written off Baek Jin Gu's claims too quickly. Later, she finds troubling information related to the Eunhyung-dong case.

episodes.title: The Birth of Satan (1)
episodes.synopsis: Jin Hyuk goes to meet Nam Sang Tae by himself, hoping for answers. Kwon Joo looks deeper into the relationship between Ji Hye, Kong Chul Hwan, and GP Development.

episodes.title: The Birth of Satan (2)
episodes.synopsis: All hell breaks loose when Kwon Joo recognizes Tae Gu's voice. A serious bus accident threatens the lives of many, including a pregnant woman and a child.

episodes.title: For the Last Golden Time (1)
episodes.synopsis: As gas continues to leak from the bus, the chance of an explosion heightens. Jin Hyuk must face the undeniable truth about Dae Shik.

episodes.title: For the Last Golden Time (2)
episodes.synopsis: Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo sneak into Tae Gu's killing lair, unaware Dae Shik is inside. Can they capture the crazed murderer before he escapes? Find out in the thrilling series finale.

episodes.title: The Second Golden Time
episodes.synopsis: When a criminal mastermind goes after one of their own, the Golden Time Team's Kang Kwon Joo butts heads with other cops over the crime. Detective Do Kang Woo sees the parallels with a murder in his past.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the Hunt
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of the crash, the mastermind runs free. Director Kang Kwon Joo aims to team up with Detective Do, but it'll be harder than she thought, and the case unfurls into something much darker.

episodes.title: Time For Judgement
episodes.synopsis: A convicted child rapist is released from prison and strikes again, to the anguish of the victim's family. Detective Do chases an all-too-familiar suspect, but nothing remains in his grasp.

episodes.title: Shh! It's a Customer's Secret (1)
episodes.synopsis: With Kwak Min Soo in the grasp of law enforcement, the situation is turned on its head when someone gets through their safe walls. An old man finds the suicide of his friend, but nothing is as it seems.

episodes.title: Shh! It's A Customer's Secret (2)
episodes.synopsis: With the life of Detective Park's wife on the line, the Golden Time Team chases after malicious voice phishers who attacked an old lady for her money.

episodes.title: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (1)
episodes.synopsis: Director Kang and Detective Do chase a stunning possible lead. An online show host makes a blood-chilling discovery in an abandoned military base.

episodes.title: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (2)
episodes.synopsis: The "zombie girl" makes her way into a nearby town, and the Golden Time Team does its best to get to her first. Director Kang is become unsure of Captain Do when she receives mysterious photos.

episodes.title: I Got Flowers Today (1)
episodes.synopsis: A pair of corpses are found on the harbors of Poongsan, and Detective Do chases the slightest hint of connection to his case. Agent Park's past troubles catch up with her and threaten her safety.

episodes.title: I Got Flowers Today (2)
episodes.synopsis: The Golden Time Team runs into twists at every turn in the case of Agent Park's abduction. Detective Do's blackouts make trouble for him again as he loses his grip on reality.

episodes.title: The Creation of Hatred
episodes.synopsis: Detective Do is thrust into a high-stakes hunt with all of Poongsan's cops out for whoever's behind the disappearance of one of their own.

episodes.title: Era Of Hate
episodes.synopsis: The serial killer reveals himself to Detective Do and Director Kang, but it only makes him lash out even more as he goes to teach the Golden Time Team a lesson.

episodes.title: Era of Hate: For the Golden Time Team!
episodes.synopsis: With the serial killer brazenly turning himself in, Director Kang can't help but think something's off. Bang Jae Soo explosively pushes Detective Do to face his past, but not everything can come out in the end.

episodes.title: The Third Golden Time!
episodes.synopsis: Kang Kwon Joo is still recovering from the explosion that severely injured her.

episodes.title: An Evil Lives in Shishiodoshi Ryokan!
episodes.synopsis: Soon after meeting with Kang Woo, the team gets a call from a tourist. She says a psychopath kidnapped her and is about to kill her

episodes.title: Pinocchio's Song
episodes.synopsis: Kang Woo returns to Korea and reports to the higher ups about what he has been doing and the cartel that is behind Doctor Fabre

episodes.title: Dark Secret Behind Soo Cheol
episodes.synopsis: The Golden Time Team gets a call about a kid named Pyo Hyun Soo. He is a kid suffering from Asperger's syndrome. However, his guardian, Song Soo Cheol, seems to be manipulating Hyun Soo

episodes.title: The Secret Of Sumpitan
episodes.synopsis: Je Soo is able to escape after faking a suicide. Soon after his escape, he comes across someone. Even when the Golden Time Team responds immediately, they lost Je Soo

episodes.title: The Revenge
episodes.synopsis: The perpetrator that shot poisonous darts has been apprehended. She reveals she wanted revenge for what Director Cheon has done to her

episodes.title: The Accelerator To The Abyss
episodes.synopsis: Hong Soo catches Kang Woo interrogating Burying Beetle at Port Poongsan. While trying to stop Kang Woo, Burying Beetle gets away. However, not everything is for naught, as Kang Woo now knows a clue related to Wire Shun. Meanwhile, the Golden Time Team gets a call from a man saying someone drunk or high has beaten him up.

episodes.title: Someone Has Kidnapped Jin Sik
episodes.synopsis: A man suspected of being Wire Shun, Fujiyama Koichi, is located at Club Blackhole. Although Kang Woo chases after him, Fujiyama gets away. Moreover, the police lose Jin Sik while he went to the bathroom. After inspecting the bathroom, Kang Woo suspects someone has kidnapped Jin Sik. Meanwhile, Cho Rong searches more about Fujiyama and comes across important information on Kang Woo.

episodes.title: Is Your Life All Right? (1)
episodes.synopsis: While searching through the area, the perpetrator makes Kang Woo turn and attack Kwon Joo. She confirms that Kang Woo is unstable and asks him to turn his gun and police badge in. The Dispatch Team finds the dead bodies of Fujiyama and his henchman. Kang Woo suspects there is someone else who controlled Fujiyama and believes this case is far from over.

episodes.title: Is Your Life All Right? (2)
episodes.synopsis: The team arrives at Dr. Hwang’s Clinic and apprehends Choo Dong Goo, who has been causing a scene. Dong Goo claims Doctor Hwang hid his soon-to-be wife, Se Mi, and something horrible has happened to her. Although Kang Woo said he wouldn’t meddle in today’s case, he spots blood in the operation room. He realizes something is off and thinks Se Mi got kidnapped.

episodes.title: The Secret Of Sameta
episodes.synopsis: Yukiko’s husband, Kaneki Masayuki, seems like an amazing professor loved by his students who stand up for human rights. Kwon Joo and Kang Woo come across him while checking on Fujiyama Koichi’s autopsy. Meanwhile, Goto Naomi, a worker who worked for Yukiko, finds a camera installed in one of the paintings that recorded the day Yukiko got murdered.

episodes.title: Kang Woo Quits His Job
episodes.synopsis: Soon after Naomi brought the painting and the camera, she gets killed. Her body was displayed just like the painting she had brought which makes the Golden Time Team think it was done by someone related to Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo quits his job and tries to go after the perpetrator by his way.

episodes.title: Golden Time Team's Crisis
episodes.synopsis: While searching the Blackhole Club, Hong Soo gets ambushed and abducted by one of Kaneki’s henchman. Thankfully, even while his hands are tied, Hong Soo gives the team some information. With the information, the team locates where Hong Soo is. Kang Woo gets to the location before the team arrives and goes after the abductor.

episodes.title: Disband The Golden Time Team
episodes.synopsis: Hong Soo gets tortured and murdered by Jeon Chang Soo. Due to this incident, police headquarters decide to disband the Golden Time Team. The team, however, gets a few days to catch the real owner of Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is going solo and tries to figure out why Professor Kaneki is so obsessed with him.

episodes.title: The City Of Accomplices
episodes.synopsis: Dispatch Team heads over to the location Kang Woo confined Chang Soo. But when they arrive at the place, Chang Soo is found dead. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is trying to find out about Kaneki’s past and goes to an old maid that worked at the Kaneki household in the past. The information the maid gives is rather shocking and makes Kang Woo remember his past.

episodes.title: Kaneki Is Stowing Away To Japan
episodes.synopsis: After obtaining Kaneki’s cellphone, the Golden Time Team locates where Kaneki went frequently. There, the team finds Congressman Makio along with the rotting bodies. But not long after such discovery, poisonous gas starts fill the building up. Meanwhile, Kaneki is heading over to his hideout, and the team thinks he is stowing away to Japan.

episodes.title: New Emails
episodes.synopsis: Strange emails are sent to Kwon Joo. She thinks they’re just prank emails, but soon, she realizes the emails have been forewarning her of murders. She starts to track down who sent the emails. Meanwhile, Derek Cho, a detective from the U.S., is working temporarily in Korea. He has a younger sister who has a speech impediment, but she’s abducted and in danger.

episodes.title: The Face Of The Suspect
episodes.synopsis: Kwon Joo and Derek finally meet in person at the Vimo Provincial Police Agency. However, when Derek checks the suspect’s face on the CCTV footage from the airport, he does not hesitate to point his gun at Kwon Joo. Meanwhile, a call comes in about a mysterious wild animal that dragged a person off in Mosim Forest.

episodes.title: The Phone Call From The Victim
episodes.synopsis: The call center receives a phone call from the missing woman, Jang Ye Sook. Kwon Joo tries her best to hear anything over the phone that might help the team get to Ye Sook in time. Meanwhile, Derek, who joins the Golden Time Team, finds a piece of clothing with a bite mark on it. The team puts all of their effort into saving the victim before it is too late.

episodes.title: The Body In The Cauldron
episodes.synopsis: The Golden Time Team heads to the hospital in search of the fleeing suspect, Gong Su Ji. Meanwhile, Han Woo Ju, a cyber agent who runs the fansite for the Golden Time Team, brings in a helpful clue. Then, a call center receives a report about a haenyeo who claims to have seen her granddaughter’s dead body in a cauldron in the sea.

episodes.title: Running Away From Danger
episodes.synopsis: Kwon Joo’s team and Derek continue to look for Su Ji and Ga Eun. Su Ji’s belongings and what seems to be her will are found near the beach, and the local police officers assume that Su Ji committed suicide. Meanwhile, Ga Eun who was abducted by the drug smugglers tries to run away, risking her life.

episodes.title: Circus Man's Multiple Personalities
episodes.synopsis: Kwon Joo’s profiling leads to the conclusion that the Circus Man is in fact a man with multiple personalities. Derek and the Golden Time Team continue questioning the suspect as Dae Shik rejoins the dispatch team. Meanwhile, a call comes into the 112 call center from a man who is being chased by someone with a knife. Kwon Joo sends the Golden Time Team to the scene.

episodes.title: 28 Years Ago
episodes.synopsis: Kang Man Ho’s father, Kang Seok Chun, is supposedly dead on paper. However, he is still alive, and his hidden story comes to light. Meanwhile, Derek hears the truth from Director Yang about his mom’s death 28 years ago. Also, Woo Ju sets up a trap online to catch the Circus Man. Meanwhile, a mysterious user approaches him.

episodes.title: The Missing Teen
episodes.synopsis: The Golden Time Team conducts a discreet operation to catch the user they believe to be Circus Man. Meanwhile, Eun Soo volunteers to transfer to the dispatch team. As they chase down Circus Man, a local high school teacher calls the 112 Call Center about his student who has gone missing after leaving an ominous voicemail.

episodes.title: Hidden Room
episodes.synopsis: Derek and Dae Shik finally catch the man who is suspected to have abducted and confined Saet Byul and Hyo Joon in a motel room. But he says he was also forced by a woman for money. Eun Soo manages to enter the motel and finds a path that leads to a hidden room. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo bumps into a stranger in a stairway, but she instantly recognizes him by his voice.

episodes.title: Short Kidnapper
episodes.synopsis: The man who Kwon Joo bumped into in the stairway was Dong Bang Min. He threatens Kwon Joo with a knife. Fortunately, Derek and Dae Sik arrive to save Kwon Joo. Dong Bang Min soon gets released thanks to the connection between the Commissioner General and his grandfather, the head of Sonang Village. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo and Derek find out more about Joo Bum Tae from his schoolmate. And they also hear about a kidnapper who is quite short.

episodes.title: Kwak Man Taek's Confession
episodes.synopsis: The Golden Time Team arrests and interrogates Kwak Man Taek, the man who works for Dong Bang Min, after he confesses that he is the Circus Man. However, during the interrogation, he has a seizure and acts very strangely. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo figures something out while analyzing Dong Bang Min’s many voices. Then, someone breaks into the Golden Time Team’s lodgings.

episodes.title: The Vimo Plant
episodes.synopsis: Kwon Joo and Derek chase after the person who snuck into the dorm. Kwon Joo sees something from a past dream that she had. Derek saves her from imminent danger, and they find out why they both saw strange visions. As the secrets of Sonang Village slowly come to light, Woo Ju informs the team that Saet Byeol has disappeared from the shelter.

episodes.title: Feud
episodes.synopsis: Fourteen years after a feud was sparked, the Qiao and Wei families become united when Xiao Qiao is sent to marry Wei Shao in her sister's place.

episodes.title: Betrothal
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao's marriage talks end poorly. Misunderstood by the people of Xindu, Wei Shao gains some support thanks to Xiao Qiao's help.

episodes.title: Expelled
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao sends Xiao Qiao away from Xindu after gaining the seal. Xiao Qiao vows to stop Liu Yan's evil plan. Wei Shao attacks Panyi.

episodes.title: Prejudices
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao is torn between Wei Shao and Liu Yan. She mourns her grandfather but, out of duty, she vows to honor her engagement.

episodes.title: The Marriage
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao attends his family's memorial, leaving the injured Xiao Qiao outside the city. She feigns weakness, stirring his guilt.

episodes.title: A Loving Couple
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao struggles with her mother-in-law. Elders urge Wei Shao to take a concubine — though seemingly loving, he is wary of the Qiao family.

episodes.title: Pay Back
episodes.synopsis: Charmed by Wei Shao's affection, Xiao Qiao begins to fall for him. Lady Zhu hopes he'll take Zheng Chuyu as a concubine. Xiao Qiao is framed.

episodes.title: Secret Planning
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao secretly helps Bi Zhi become commander of Boya. Under Gongsun Yang's guidance, Wei Shao learns how to behave toward his wife.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao learns he's been used, straining his bond with Xiao Qiao. Lady Xu warns Xiao Qiao, who uncovers Wei Shao's weakness.

episodes.title: Lingering Fear
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao defends a targeted Wei Shao, deepening their bond. Wei Shao asks Xiao Qiao to organize Lady Xu's birthday banquet.

episodes.title: A Birthday Gift
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao faces setbacks while putting together a gift for Lady Xu. Provoked by Wei Yan, Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao have a terrible fight.

episodes.title: Instigate
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao urges Wei Shao to divert water from Yanzhou to relieve the drought. Wei Yan's revelations about Wei Shao lead Xiao Qiao to feel betrayed.

episodes.title: Sulking
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao agrees to repair the canal to smooth his relationship with Xiao Qiao. Lady Su E Huang arrives for a visit — but she has an ulterior motives.

episodes.title: Lady Yulou's Visit
episodes.synopsis: Su E Huang meets Wei Shao alone, upsetting Xiao Qiao. Grain sent by the Qiao family is destroyed — and Xiao Qiao and Wei Yan are blamed.

episodes.title: Find the Culprit
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao prompts Wei Yan to reconcile with his grandmother, then takes action to resolve the conflict between Lady Zhu and Wei Shao.

episodes.title: Mediate
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao and Xiao Qiao grow closer when they travel to Rong County. A conspiracy against Wei Shao begins to unfold.

episodes.title: Probing
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao faces trouble. Xiao Qiao helps him rally the troops. After Yuan Wang and Wei Dian oppose the canal plan, Xiao Qiao plots to drive them apart.

episodes.title: Stargazing Date
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao tries to deepen her bond with Wei Shao. Yuan Wang's daughter falls for Wei Liang, unaware that his heart belongs to another.

episodes.title: Real Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao and his party return to Yu County, but Xiao Qiao has an accident. After the scare, they finally open their hearts to each other.

episodes.title: Truly Cares
episodes.synopsis: Da Qiao and her husband live peacefully. As Wei Shao's relationship with his mother improves, his feelings for Xiao Qiao are confirmed.

episodes.title: Live Without Her
episodes.synopsis: After avoiding Xiao Qiao for a while, Wei Shao resolves to reconcile with his feelings, which leads their relationship to deepen.

episodes.title: Jealousy
episodes.synopsis: Wei Yan hides his feelings for Xiao Qiao. Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao attend a New Year ceremony together, and grow closer.

episodes.title: Heart-guarding Mirror
episodes.synopsis: Da Qiao helps Bi Zhi bolster his position. An ill-intentioned Su E Huang shows up. Liu Yan prepares to make his move at the upcoming assembly.

episodes.title: The Deer Hunt
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao welcomes Qiao Ci, then exposes Su E Huang. On the day of the assembly, Qiao Ci and Su Zi Xin confront each other.

episodes.title: Change of Reputation
episodes.synopsis: A successful Qiao Ci helps Wei Shao with the canal project. Wei Shao and Xiao Qiao open up to each other. Su E Huang tries to win over Liu Yan.

episodes.title: Seducing Wei Shao
episodes.synopsis: Su E Huang fails to seduce Wei Shao. Gao Heng leaves Yu County. Su E Huang discovers Wei Yan’s feelings for Xiao Qiao.

episodes.title: Spreading Rumours
episodes.synopsis: A jealous Wei Shao quarrels with Xiao Qiao before making up. To protect them, Wei Yan decides to reveal what really happened.

episodes.title: Telling the Truth
episodes.synopsis: Wei Yan leaves Yu County. Punished and exiled, Su E Huang vows revenge. Liu Yan leads his troops to war on behalf of Su E Huang.

episodes.title: Attacking Yanzhou
episodes.synopsis: Liu Yan leads his troops on the offensive. Wei Shao faces a dilemma. Xiao Qiao seeks help. Wei Yan attempts to support Wei Shao.

episodes.title: Heartbroken
episodes.synopsis: Xiao Qiao risks her life to join Wei Shao and successfully persuades the enemy forces to retreat. Liu Yan withdraws.

episodes.title: Knelt down
episodes.synopsis: After a misunderstanding, Wei Shao rushes after Xiao Qiao. Da Qiao and her husband decide to return to Kang County. Wei Shao opens up to Xiao Qiao.

episodes.title: Knelt Down
episodes.synopsis: Liu Yan decides to pursue the traitor. The Qiao family reunites. Wei Shao makes overtures to Xiao Qiao's family, and to include her in his.

episodes.title: Good Luck
episodes.synopsis: Su E Huang does what it takes to motivate Liu Yan. Xiao Qiao surprises Wei Shao. Wei Liang heads to Kang County.

episodes.title: Sever All Ties
episodes.synopsis: Qiao Ping is trapped. Da Qiao is in danger. Wei Liang dies in a battle. Wei Shao vows revenge.

episodes.title: Unpredictable Outcome
episodes.synopsis: Wei Shao leads his troops into battle. Su E Huang claims a victory. Qiao Ping is rescued and sends reinforcements to Wei Shao.

episodes.title: At War
episodes.synopsis: Wei Yan shows up at a critical moment. Bi Zhi and Wei Shao join forces for a siege. Liu Yan is defeated. Peace is achieved at last.

episodes.title: Incident
episodes.synopsis: In a crime-heavy district of Xizhou, the body of a young man is discovered. Special Investigation Division (SID) officer Luo Weizhao arrives at the scene, where suspicions arise linking this to previous drug-related cases. The scene also draws the attention of Pei Su, the young president of the Pei Group.

episodes.title: Conditions of Intervention
episodes.synopsis: Luo Weizhao’s team identifies a suspect, Zhang Donglan, who is connected to a high-profile group and the SID chief. Pei Su, with his own ties to the case, undergoes questioning.

episodes.title: Informant
episodes.synopsis: An anonymous tipster, Chen Zhen, implicates a drug ring in his sister’s death. Tension escalates when the victim’s mother confronts Zhang Donglan after his release.

episodes.title: Portrait of My Mother
episodes.synopsis: A raid on a nightclub uncovers new evidence. A crucial clue from a surveillance camera refocuses the investigation.

episodes.title: Where Does Conceit End Up?
episodes.synopsis: The suspect's alias and tragic past come to light. Luo Weizhao takes a more personal approach to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Peeping Gaze
episodes.synopsis: While celebrating a birthday, Pei Su notices a mysterious gaze following a child — hinting at a new threat.

episodes.title: Repro
episodes.synopsis: A new case involving a missing girl echoes a cold case from 16 years ago. Luo Weizhao revisits the father of a past victim for leads.

episodes.title: The Next Target
episodes.synopsis: A girl vanishes during Pei Su’s birthday dinner. The team connects her disappearance to a survivor of a similar past case.

episodes.title: Enchanted Madness
episodes.synopsis: Clues lead to a chilling diary found with human remains. A twisted relationship and dark secrets emerge.

episodes.title: Intern
episodes.synopsis: The investigation uncovers new truths about a cold case, and two new interns, including Pei Su, join the SID

episodes.title: Behind the Fame
episodes.synopsis: A corporate heir is kidnapped. Family secrets and power struggles within the Zhou Group surface.

episodes.title: Whispers of Revenge
episodes.synopsis: A shocking package from the past revives questions about a suspicious death. The SID follows new leads.

episodes.title: That Day Forever
episodes.synopsis: A series of deaths and a fire point to a larger conspiracy. Pei Su and Luo Weizhao uncover secrets buried in Pei’s childhood home.

episodes.title: The Mechanism of the Accident
episodes.synopsis: As suspects flee, more details about the Zhou Group’s shady rise to power are exposed.

episodes.title: The Voice That Splits the Light
episodes.synopsis: A car explosion puts Pei Su’s life at risk. The SID closes in on a shadowy figure.

episodes.title: Conversations in the Dusk
episodes.synopsis: Pei Su recovers in the hospital and begins to trust Luo. A mysterious visitor brings insight into Pei’s past.

episodes.title: A Final Message from the Mentor
episodes.synopsis: Luo receives a cryptic letter from his late mentor. A new case begins as five students disappear.

episodes.title: Unfathomable Footsteps
episodes.synopsis: A mutilated body is found. Surveillance footage identifies a long-wanted criminal from the "327 Case".

episodes.title: Their Order
episodes.synopsis: A student reveals a hidden hierarchy of abuse within a boarding school.

episodes.title: The Roots of Trust
episodes.synopsis: Interrogation reveals manipulation and cover-ups. A victim tried to expose systemic violence before his death.

episodes.title: Exchange of Sincerity
episodes.synopsis: Trust is tested as Pei Su speculates he might be the "Purifier". Luo Weizhao affirms his belief in Pei.

episodes.title: Pursuit
episodes.synopsis: The team traces surveillance footage to uncover the criminal’s hideout.

episodes.title: Pursuit
episodes.synopsis: A drone-supported raid leads to the discovery of a planted bomb — an ominous escalation.

episodes.title: Into a New Chapter
episodes.synopsis: Old injustices resurface. Luo Weizhao uncovers secrets tied to the notorious Seine Riverside case.

episodes.title: Emerging Structure
episodes.synopsis: The team discovers the star witness was impersonated. The SID suspects an internal leak.

episodes.title: Tracing Memory
episodes.synopsis: Pei Su delves into his subconscious for answers, learning the identity of a missing professor.

episodes.title: The Mole
episodes.synopsis: A bug is found on an SID member. Pei Su and others suspect a high-level traitor.

episodes.title: Connected Pieces
episodes.synopsis: A repressed memory reveals a key player in past cases. A shocking disappearance changes the game.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.synopsis: All forces converge at an abandoned mansion — the site of a past murder. Loyalties are tested.

episodes.title: Beyond the Darkness
episodes.synopsis: The final confrontation forces a life-or-death decision. Pei Su and Luo Weizhao face the ultimate moral challenge.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Zhen Huan reluctantly prepares to meet the Emperor.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Zhen Huan is chosen by the Emperor, who seems to recognise something about her. While devastated that she must now leave her family, she is determined to do well in the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Consort Hua shows her true colours when she harshly punishes a petty bully, however, the darker nature of the palace soon reveals itself to Zhen Huan when she makes a horrifying find.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Zhen Huan becomes sick after witnessing the corpse, and calls upon her friend, Dr Wen, for assistance. Meanwhile, the Emperor takes increasing interest in Shen Meizhuang.

episodes.title: The Grid Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip, a headstrong 13-year-old girl, finds a mysterious train where every car contains its own universe.

episodes.title: The Beach Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip strikes a deal with a cat in an attempt to get home, but is the price worth it?

episodes.title: The Corgi Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip and One-One explore a car full of Corgis and face off against a mysterious monster.

episodes.title: The Crystal Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip, Atticus and One-One enter a crystal forest car and have to take part in a musical ritual.

episodes.title: The Cat's Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip has to face her past.

episodes.title: The Unfinished Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang enters an unfinished train car and tries to fix it.

episodes.title: The Chrome Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang meets a familiar face in a mirrored car.

episodes.title: The Ball Pit Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang is confronted by a strange new force on a Ball Pit Car adventure.

episodes.title: The Past Car
episodes.synopsis: Tulip takes a risk trusting an old foe.

episodes.title: The Engine
episodes.synopsis: Tulip makes it to the front of the train and is faced with a choice.

episodes.title: The Black Market Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip tries to create a new life for herself outside the Mirror World.

episodes.title: The Family Tree Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip and Jesse climb down a real life family tree.

episodes.title: The Map Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip tries to help get Jesse’s number down.

episodes.title: The Toad Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip and Jesse get stuck in a car and face an unusual dilemma.

episodes.title: The Parasite Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip and Jesse gain an unexpected companion.

episodes.title: The Lucky Cat Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip and Jesse enter a carnival car and have to compete for the exit.

episodes.title: The Mall Car
episodes.synopsis: Someone mysterious invites Jesse and Mirror Tulip into a mall car.

episodes.title: The Wasteland
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip finds herself in the wasteland outside the train.

episodes.title: The Tape Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip searches for answers.

episodes.title: The Number Car
episodes.synopsis: Mirror Tulip fights for the right to make her own choices.

episodes.title: The Musical Car
episodes.synopsis: The kids of The Apex raid a musical car before descending on a village of unsuspecting turtles - but before they can complete their mission, leaders Grace and Simon are separated from the pack under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: The Jungle Car
episodes.synopsis: Grace and Simon look on the bright side and hope that this will be like a mini-vacation from their responsibilities as leaders of The Apex.

episodes.title: The Debutante Ball Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang's uneasy alliance is tested by a challenge in their first car together: dancing in a high-stakes octopus debutante ball!

episodes.title: Le Chat Chalet Car
episodes.synopsis: Stuck in a blizzard, the gang seeks shelter in a nearby cabin. But when Simon realizes who's inside, he frantically searches for a way out.

episodes.title: The Color Clock Car
episodes.synopsis: A giant, color-changing clock creates a shifting-maze puzzle that the gang has to solve before they can leave the car.

episodes.title: The Campfire Car
episodes.synopsis: The Apex are just a car away! They're almost home! But first they have to make it through a forest full of pinecone camp counselors.

episodes.title: The Canyon of the Golden Winged Snakes Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang finds themselves in a car full of golden winged snakes, but in that dusty landscape a mystery they're unprepared for awaits them.

episodes.title: The Hey Ho Whoa Car
episodes.synopsis: In the seemingly innocent Hey Ho Whoa car, a shocking revelation rocks Grace and Simon's world. Will they be able to fix it before The Apex find out?

episodes.title: The Origami Car
episodes.synopsis: The gang is finally ready to meet The Apex again, but keeping secrets has consequences.

episodes.title: The New Apex
episodes.synopsis: The gang reorders The Apex, but what will the new order be?

episodes.title: The Twin Tapes
episodes.synopsis: Once great friends, Ryan and Min-Gi's relationship slowly dissolves over the course of years of disgruntlement, culminating with their reunion in the restaurant.

episodes.title: The Iceberg Car
episodes.synopsis: Waking up on the train together, Ryan and Min-Gi are met by Kez, whose mistake has left the boys in a predicament.

episodes.title: The Old West Car
episodes.synopsis: Arriving in a Wild West town, Ryan, Min-Gi, and Kez attempt to escape the locals.

episodes.title: The Pig Baby Car
episodes.synopsis: Ryan and Min-Gi are forced to satisfy Pig Baby with the perfect dessert.

episodes.title: The Astro Queue Car
episodes.synopsis: With a growing rift forming between them, Ryan and Min-Gi attempt to convince a bouncer to let them enter the rave.

episodes.title: The Party Car
episodes.synopsis: With their instruments back, Ryan and Min-Gi have to play their first show since they were kids, but it's no easy emotional feat.

episodes.title: The Art Gallery Car
episodes.synopsis: The boys' disintegrating relationship finally comes to a head when they end up in a haunted art museum with seemingly no exit.

episodes.title: The Mega Maze Car
episodes.synopsis: As the duo nears Kez's home, they are forced to contend both with all their enemies and their messy relationship.

episodes.title: The Castle Car
episodes.synopsis: Having finally arrived at Kez's home, Ryan and Min-Gi learn of her biggest secret and regret.

episodes.title: The Train to Nowhere
episodes.synopsis: Ryan and Min-Gi are forced to face the truth and a final challenge if they ever want to go home.

episodes.title: Super a Reincarnation? The Goddess Confessed to Me!
Upgrade! Battle 5? Not to Be Feared!
Melee! Is Wang Xiaoxiu Still Human?
Brave Climb Tower: A Fight With Explosive Funds
Being Tricked By a Black-Hearted Agent Into Working as a Bodyguard
Rudra Feast: Warriors and Golden Bells
Rudra Feast: The Strength of the Young Lady
Assassination of Prince Pengcheng
episodes.synopsis: During the Yuanjia period of the Liu Song Dynasty, the righteous and kindhearted chivalrous woman Lige, seeking to avenge the murder of her parents, disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the powerful and treacherous minister Lu Yuan. She intends to assassinate Prince Pengcheng. Lu Yuan agrees to her plan, and they decide to take action at Grand Consort Sun's birthday banquet.

episodes.title: Making the Escape
episodes.synopsis: Senior Brother helps Lige to escape from Prince Pengcheng's Mansion, while the Prince Pengcheng is trapped in the fire and cannot break open the door to escape.

episodes.title: Gaining Trust
episodes.synopsis: As Lige returns home, her mother offers the Jia Ning Pavilion to her, much to the chagrin of Leqing.

episodes.title: Capturing the Witnesses
episodes.synopsis: The Prince Pengcheng has Pei Ruhai interrogated overnight, and Pei Ruhai truthfully confesses to helping Lu Yuan manufacture weapons illegally.

episodes.title: Bestowed Marriage
episodes.synopsis: Knowing that Mrs. Shen is ill, the Emperor not only asks Prince Pengcheng to give medicine to General Shen, but also bestows marriage on the daughter of Shen family and Prince Pengcheng.

episodes.title: Exposing The Lies
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng and Lige survive the assassination attempt and get out of the water. Prince Pengcheng jokingly complains that Lige brings nothing but trouble every time he sees her. Lige ignores him and treats his injuries.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.synopsis: Lige comes to the dungeon to find Lu Yuan and wants to negotiate with him. She proposes that if the eldest daughter of the Shen family assassinates King Pengcheng at the wedding, the Shen family can be overthrown.

episodes.title: Revealing the True Face
episodes.synopsis: The strong man locks Prince Pengcheng and Lige in a small room. Prince Pengcheng takes out Lige's hairpin and asks her to open the lock on his hand.

episodes.title: Siege of Mount Qixia
episodes.synopsis: Lige visits the Lu family at night and learns that Lu Yuan has decided to kill all the craftsmen after casting the last batch of weapons. Lige tells Prince Pengcheng the news.

episodes.title: Poisoned
episodes.synopsis: General Shen and his son are taken away by Lu Yuan, while Lige is poisoned and rescued by Shaoxun and Kong Cheng.

episodes.title: The Antidote
episodes.synopsis: Prince Jingling goes to Lu Yuan angrily and asks him why he wants to harm the Shen father and son, and Lige. However, Lu Yuan reminds him not to forget that he and the Lu family are relatives.

episodes.title: Suspicion
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pencheng suggests to Lige that they can rescue her family and get rid of Lu Yuan by having him command his troops to besiege Jiankang.

episodes.title: The Hoax
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng tricks Lu Yuan and keeps him trapped in the prison. Next, he has his men spread the news that Lu Yuan has been captured and imprisoned by the Ministry of Justice.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng asks Prince Jingling why he issued the order as it comes at a great cost. However, Prince Jingling believes that making sacrifices for success is inevitable.

episodes.title: Taking the Blame
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng tells his ministers that Prince Jingling trains his own soldiers on his orders and publicly points out that Lu Yuan intends to rebel.

episodes.title: New Mission
episodes.synopsis: Lige and Prince Pengcheng hang out together and grow closer to each other. However, Lige's master has a new mission for her to kill Prince Pengcheng on the wedding day.

episodes.title: Into the Heart
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng and Lige go on a boat ride together. He is curious to know her true identity, yet she remains reluctant.

episodes.title: Fanning the Flames
episodes.synopsis: Shen Leqing deliberately discusses the scar on Lige's body with Lingxi. After hearing this, the Grand Consort asks Lige to come and see her.

episodes.title: Eradicating Maladies
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng takes in some poor students to study in his palace, hoping to change the bad habit of judging official rank based on bloodline and allowing the children of high-ranking families to enter the officialdom without taking an exam. However, Prince Jingling is worried that the aristocratic families will not give up.

episodes.title: Only You
episodes.synopsis: General Shen advises Shen Zhi not to get too close to Zijin. The more he cares, the more hurt he'll feel. However, Shen Zhi insists on marrying no one but Zijin.

episodes.title: Expose
episodes.synopsis: Seeing that Shen Leqing is still quibbling, Shen Lige comes up with another way to identify the real murderer. If someone who has touched Blood Wither comes into contact with water, their hands will turn black.

episodes.title: The Assassination
episodes.synopsis: Despite knowing Consort Li has moved into Han Ling Pavilion, Prince Pengcheng can't stop thinking about Lige. On the wedding day, Lige hides her face behind a red fan as she prepares to assassinate Prince Pengcheng.

episodes.title: Bearing His Pain
episodes.synopsis: Lu Yuan senses the pain on Prince Pengcheng and suspects that he's injured. He decides to stall and wait for Prince Pengcheng to give the game away.

episodes.title: Detoxify
episodes.synopsis: Shen Lige learns that the Grand Consort has agarwood and decides to steal it while paying respects to her. She goes to the Grand Consort's medicine room and sees Shen Leqing.

episodes.title: The Condition Worsens
episodes.synopsis: Seeing Prince Pengcheng's condition deteriorate, Lige grows anxious. When Shaoxun asks the master for tiger gall, the master suddenly changes his temperament. Not only does he refuse to give the antidote, but he also attacks Shaoxun.

episodes.title: Revealing the Identity
episodes.synopsis: Grand Consort Sun tells Lige not to think she doesn't know her background. She is the one who attempted to assassinate Prince Pengcheng at the birthday banquet.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.synopsis: Lige visits the Princess. She confesses that she attempted the assassination of Prince Pengcheng when the Princess questions her.

episodes.title: After Waking Up
episodes.synopsis: Lu Yuan brings the coroner and stops the people from the Court of Justice. Prince Jingling asks him why he is so anxious to perform the autopsy. The two are in a stalemate.

episodes.title: Determination
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng gives Prince Jingling the outline of the new policy he has carefully compiled and tells Prince Jingling that if anything happens to him, he must stick to the new policy for the sake of the Song Dynasty.

episodes.title: Magic Remedy
episodes.synopsis: Chen Shaoxun reads through medicine books to find the remedy for Lige. He then finds out that snow lotus can treat Lige's ailment.

episodes.title: Missing Each Other
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng, at the northern border, sees the pear blossoms and thinks of Shen Lige. At the same time, Shen Lige is also missing him.

episodes.title: Kind and Stubborn
episodes.synopsis: Grand Consort Sun asks Prince Jingling to stop doing those thankless things, but Prince Jingling insists that everything he does is for the country and the people.

episodes.title: Rescuing the Lover
episodes.synopsis: The general of the Wei army leads his men to attack General Shen, who is alone outside the city, to see if Prince Pengcheng will come to his rescue. Zijin asks Prince Pengcheng to rush over with reinforcements to save him.

episodes.title: The Wedding
episodes.synopsis: In order to boost morale, Prince Pengcheng decides to have Shen Zhi and Zijin hold their wedding that night.

episodes.title: Fearless
episodes.synopsis: Lu Yuan mistakenly thinks that Prince Pengcheng is dead and feels relieved. But Prince Pengcheng learns of Lu Yuan's conspiracy and attacks Lu Yuan's men together with Lige.

episodes.title: A Fake Death
episodes.synopsis: Secretariat Xie pleads with Prince Jingling, saying that since Lu Yuan has returned from the frontier, even if he has done nothing wrong, he has done nothing wrong. Other clan officials also echo his opinion, and Prince Jingling has no choice but to let Lu Yuan go temporarily.

episodes.title: Conflict Between Mother and Son
episodes.synopsis: Lu Yuan asks Prince Jingling to hand over the Danyang soldiers' military token. Seeing that Prine Jingling refuses, he has someone put a sword to the Grand Consort's neck, and Prince Jingling has no choice but to hand over the military token to him.

episodes.title: Nowhere to Stay
episodes.synopsis: The soldiers want to arrest the remnants of the Lu family. Wan'Er has nowhere to go, so she comes to the place where she used to play the zither with Prince Jingling, but she does not dare to come out to meet him.

episodes.title: Lovebirds
episodes.synopsis: At court, Prince Pengcheng rewards the Shen family and appoints Shen Feng as a general. When Prince Pengcheng returns home, he finds Lige cooking for him. Although the food she cooks is salty and unpalatable, Prince Pengcheng still pretends to enjoy it.

episodes.title: Rectifying the Clans
episodes.synopsis: To implement the new policy, Prince Pengcheng asks Fang Qing, an official from a poor family background, to conduct an inventory of the land owned by the clans.

episodes.title: Ominous Premonition
episodes.synopsis: Shen Leqing copies Shen's mother's handwriting and writes a letter asking General Shen to meet at Weiyang Lake. General Shen has no doubts at all.

episodes.title: Parted by Death
episodes.synopsis: Shen Feng brings the bodies of his father and brother home, and Lige and Zijin are heartbroken.

episodes.title: Capturing the Murderer
episodes.synopsis: After burying her father and brother, Lige begins to plan to capture the murderer Xue Qiu, and Shen Feng insists on going with her.

episodes.title: Distorting the Facts
episodes.synopsis: Xue Qiu confesses to murdering General Shen and his son in front of Lige, but when he comes to court, he claims that his accomplice is Prince Pengcheng.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.synopsis: Lige accidentally hears Zijin say that Weiyang Lake was where her parents got engaged. Since Shen Leqing also knows about this, she suspects that this matter is related to Shen Leqing.

episodes.title: Civil Uprising
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng receives urgent news that civil uprisings have occurred in Chenjun, Jingzhou, and Jiankang. He guesses that Secretariat Xie and others are behind this.

episodes.title: Justice Knows No Kinship
episodes.synopsis: In Secretariat Xie's study, Old Master Xie finds the covenant. He asks Secretariat Xie to follow him to confess his crime to Prince Pengcheng, but Secretariat Xie, thinking he is old and confused, pushes him down.

episodes.title: Irrefutable Evidence
episodes.synopsis: Xue Qiu confesses that he colluded with Secretariat Xie to kill General Shen and his son, leading to Secretariat Xie being thrown into prison.

episodes.title: Peaceful Life
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng is very happy when he learns that Lige is taking medicine for childbirth. He has the swords and daggers put away so that Lige can stay at home and be a devoted wife and mother.

episodes.title: A Careful Plot
episodes.synopsis: Grand Consort gives Prince Pengcheng a drug that makes him lose his mind, puts a dagger in his hand, and then smiles, saying that today is both her birthday and her memorial day.

episodes.title: Seeing Through the Trap
episodes.synopsis: Old Master Wang brings all the ministers to Sanjiu Hall, and Prince Pengcheng surprisingly takes the initiative to admit it. Lige wants to step forward to stop him, but Prince Pengcheng winks at her, and she guesses that there must be another meaning behind it.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng explains to Old Master Wang how he joined forces with Prince Jingling. Seeing the situation as hopeless, Old Master Wang suddenly sets fire to the room, then takes Zijin and goes into the secret passage.

episodes.title: Unwilling to Part
episodes.synopsis: Prince Pengcheng rushes to see the emperor, asking him to withdraw his order to execute Lige, but the emperor is unwilling to see him.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Si-eun is a model student who is always at the top of his school. Because he only cares about his studies, he has no friends at school. Young-bin, a boy in Si-eun's class, is annoyed by Si-eun's cynical attitude. On a mock test day, Young-bin decides to use Bum-seok, a new student, to mess with Si-eun's test.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Young-bin wants revenge on Si-eun for putting him in the hospital by hiring a couple of thugs he knows. Meanwhile, Si-eun gets closer to Soo-ho and becomes friends. Later, Soo-ho comes to Si-eun's rescue when he gets confronted by Young-bin and his thugs.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: When Gil-su sees his boys beaten up to a pulp, he gets furious and asks who did it. Young-bin lures Si-eun, Bum-seok, and Soo-ho and takes them to Gil-su. Gil-su threatens them to bring him 15 million won in three days. Si-eun asks Young for advice and information on Gil-su.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Si-eun sees Soo-ho's blood on the floor and calls Young-yi for help. Gil-su tells Seok-dae to come, so Young-yi follows him with her GPS tracking app on. Meanwhile, Soo-ho and Bum-seok are tied up by Gil-su's gang.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: While hanging out in a karaoke room with his friends, Bum-seok runs into the bullies from his previous school. Soo-ho makes them apologize, but Bum-seok isn't happy with Soo-ho ordering him around. Si-eun becomes more worried about Bum-seok who seems to be getting more unstable.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Bum-seok befriends with Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon, he reeks of alcohol every day. Si-eun thinks Bum-seok is being used by Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon. He also thinks Bum-seok is behaving that way because he is lonely. Si-eun wants to help Bum-seok, but Soo-ho thinks he's done enough. Meanwhile, Bum-seok pays Woo-young to beat Soo-ho on his birthday.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Si-eun gets beaten up by the guys Bum-seok paid to beat up Soo-ho. Si-eun gets seriously injured, but he doesn't tell Soo-ho about it to protect Bum-seok. Soo-ho finds out later and decides to confront Bum-seok. Bum-seok pays Woo-young again to beat up Soo-ho.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Si-eun and Young-yi get anxious as they can't get hold of Soo-ho for too long. After Si-eun finishes his exams, he hears the shocking news. Meanwhile, Bum-seok's dad tries to make Bum-seok go study abroad.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Still affected by what happened to Su-ho, Si-eun withdraws from others. Seo Jun-tae contemplates taking a stand against the bullies — despite the risks.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: After being saved by Si-eun, Jun-tae attempts to befriend him — but both are soon dragged into Choi Hyo-man's revenge plot involving Go Hyun-tak.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: While doing volunteer work as punishment for fighting, Si-eun begins to form a bond with new friends — but trouble continues to find him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: After Geum Seong-je crosses the line, Si-eun strikes a deal with Na Baek-jin — leaving Park Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Jun-tae alone in the violent crosshairs.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Worried for his father and backed into a corner, Hu-min confronts Baek-jin. Si-eun considers studying abroad after clashing with his distressed mother.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Si-eun, Jun-tae, and Hyun-tak seek out Hu-min, who has decided to work with Baek-jin to keep the peace. Still, Hu-min finds it difficult to comply.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: As Si-eun's absence leaves a gap, Baek-jin presses on with his violent mission. In response, Hu-min rallies his school and challenges him to a showdown.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Eunjang students gather to engage in a final confrontation against Baek-jin's gang. In the end, who will prevail?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim is an ordinary salaryman whose biggest worry is how to connect with his daughter Kim Min-ji — until she suddenly goes missing.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.synopsis: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.synopsis: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.
